diagnosis.what_happened: Script hardcoded fabricated search strings and used character-by-character regex XML tag insertion, which failed to match across whitespace, half-spaces, and runs. The script lacked checks for replacement success, leading to silent passes.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Silent regex zero match failure due to lack of assertion that replacements_count > 0.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Extract exact strings from source document; use robust XML DOM paragraph/run text inspection; assert replacements_count > 0 on every substitution to fail fast.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Failing fast ensures that issues with text matching are immediately caught, rather than corrupting the pipeline with silent non-changes.

desired_behavior: Extract exact strings from source document; use robust XML DOM paragraph/run text inspection; assert replacements_count > 0 on every substitution to fail fast instead of failing silently.
generalization: Always assert replacement success (assert replacements_count > 0) when mutating text or XML strings to prevent silent failures.

evidence.observed_value: Zero matches during regex substitution without error
